# Justin Garcia

> Justin Garcia is a Tokyo-based software engineer building iOS and real-time speech AI products at Kotoba. He previously worked at Apple, Procore, and iHeartMedia.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://onemorething.tokyo/): About Justin, independently published products, and contact links.
- [Resume](https://onemorething.tokyo/resume.html): Work history, accomplishments, independent products, education, and patents.

## Independent products

- [Sasu](https://sasu.jp/): On-screen guidance for foreigners living abroad.
- [Kehai](https://kehai.jp/): Window organization and faster app switching.
- [Kotai](https://kotai.jp/): Separate work and personal coding configurations in Cursor.
- [Karui](https://karui.jp/): Silence spam notifications and reveal unsent messages on iPhone, privately with Apple Intelligence.
- [Ume](https://onemorething.tokyo/ume.html): Private autofill for forms.
- [Yubi](https://onemorething.tokyo/yubi.html): Translate on-screen content and Japanese text input.
- [Tsugu](https://onemorething.tokyo/tsugu.html): Translate and forward Slack notifications to a phone.
